title: Nia and the Melty Chocolate
markdown:
Whoooo knows the secrets of the sun? It paints the world with warmth, slowly and with patience. Consider young Nia, who loved puzzles. Today, her puzzle was a chocolate rabbit for her friend, Pebble the puppy. Nia placed the rabbit on a blanket in a sunny spot.

Soon, the rabbit’s ears felt soft. The sunshine gave it a very warm hug. The whole rabbit looked like a happy brown puddle, spreading on the blanket. "Oh dear," Nia whispered. "Why is it doing this?"

Her neighbor, Ms. Lark, called out, "Good morning, Nia! Enjoying this warm day?"

"My chocolate rabbit is melting!" Nia sighed.

Ms. Lark smiled. "That sun is warm. It helps flowers grow. And some things, like your chocolate, get soft and melty when warm. If you cool them down, they become firm again."

Nia watched the melty chocolate. She remembered how firm it was from the cool box. Now, in the sun, it flowed. Suddenly, Nia understood! "So… the sun makes it hot," she said, pointing, "and the heat makes it melt?"

"Exactly!" Ms. Lark confirmed. "When things get warm enough, their tiny bits dance and wiggle, and they flow! When you cool them down, those bits settle, and the thing becomes firm again."

Nia’s eyes lit up. The sun was too warm for the melty chocolate. But under the big, shady oak tree, there was a cool spot.

"I have an idea!" Nia chirped. She carefully scooped the melty chocolate onto the blanket. With Pebble trotting beside her, she moved the blanket to the shady spot.

They sat quietly. Nia watched the melty chocolate. Slowly, it began to get firmer. The wiggly bits were settling down. Pebble rested his head on Nia’s knee. The air smelled like cool earth.

After a little while, Nia touched the chocolate. It was firm again! It wasn't a rabbit shape, but it was solid. She broke off a piece for Pebble, who ate it with happy slurps. Nia took a bite. It tasted delicious.

"It worked!" she cheered softly.

Ms. Lark smiled. "Whoooo could have guessed that warmth can change things, and coolness can change them back! The world is a clever place."

Nia nodded. "So, when things get too warm, they melt," she said, looking at Pebble’s chocolate-smudged face. "And when they get cool, they get solid again! It's like a puzzle that solves itself if you put it in the right place."

She took another bite, a happy smile spreading across her face. She understood a little more about the sun's gentle power. It was a wonderful secret. She wondered what else the warm sun and the cool shade could do.
characters: Nia the puzzle lover, Pebble the puppy, Ms. Lark
